system.techEffect: You evade a foe’s attack like a moonbeam slipping behind the clouds. If you totally evade the enemy’s strike, you gain an (Achieved Rank) Senses action to hide.

system.requirements: the scent of blood in the air (a lot of practitioners bite their tongues and spit prior to battle)
system.techEffect: Berzerkergang: Facing 0, enter a berserk state, sacrificing your Effortless defense this round to either lose Disadvantage if you have it or gain Advantage for the remainder of the round. Note that this doesn’t improve your situation; it merely makes you too crazy to care about it.

Enhances Bullet Eater Sutra - costs given above are only used when boosting spirit.

Whenever you transform devoured metal into a weapon, it can now transform your arm into a massive, cannon-like appendage. With this mighty new weapon, you can launch three powerful new attacks. You may pay the Prana cost listed in brackets to launch these attacks at any time during your turn.

(40) Pranic Fury Beam: Attack, Rank +5 Facing 6-9, single-target heat laser. No kinetic force, discharges as raw heat; creates a secondary Rank 5 Fire hazard at the point of impact on the target as they burst into flames.

(30) Howling Ghost Bullet: Attack, Rank +3 Facing 3-6 ordnance blast. The fat, spherical orb of throbbing Prana explodes on impact, striking the primary target at  (Achieved Rank) and the surrounding Field at (Rank 3).

(30) Soul-Emptying Round: Attack, Rank +3 Facing 0-3. Hits
and passes through a target like a ghost, warping their Prana Meridians. Empties Prana from the target’s pool instead of dealing damage. If their Prana is reduced to 0 and there is any “damage” remaining, it creates a Spiritual Imbalance of any type you can create.
Hardening your body with Earth-Prana, you make your skin and bones as solid as rock, deflecting or absorbing a blow.

You slip free from all earthly restraints. You may use this Technique to escape from any grab, hold, restraint, or any impediment to your freedom of movement. Additionally, it creates an Agility Movement action equal to (Technique Rank), propelling you in a direction of your choosing.

defenseBoost.name: Impenetrable Block Drill
defenseBoost.to: a block with your arm or leg.

system.techEffect:
Martial Discipline Supremacy: At the start of every round of combat, if you’re in fistfighting range of a foe, you gain Advantage, or lose Disadvantage if you have it

All-Weapon Fist: Facing 0, your bare hands or feet gain the power of any single non-mechanical weapon (including bows but excluding guns). You may instead pay the activation cost of the weapon in Prana to add the weapon’s bonus to any bare-handed action.

You can command (although not create) any earthaligned
substance.

You can reshape solid earth (ie; dirt and mud) as though it were pliable as water, although not stone or harder materials. You must physically interact with the substance to affect it.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create an earth-based environmental Hazard of (Achieved Rank), although you retain no control of the hazard once unleashed (so you could not stop a mudslide you cause with this Technique, you’ve got to let it naturally peter out). Such Hazards include sinkholes, mudslides, tremors, dust-devils, and other minor but dangerous phenomena.

Only works against melee-range foes. You use the butt of your gun to defend yourself. If you completely guard against a foe’s attack, they lose Advantage, or you either lose Disadvantage if you have it or gain Advantage if you don’t.
A straightforward attack that leverages the obvious advantages of a heavy weapon. Great at smashing the terrain too.

Adds to Senses.

Alternatively, if you attack from hiding, you can use this Technique to add +2 Ranks to your attack.
This quick strike is weaker than average, but can be used more frequently due to its lower cost.
This inexpensive, mid-ranged attack rounds out the tactical library of the heavy-weapon expert.

Landslide Crush: Facing 8, +1 a Grab attack.

Earthsight: You can “see” through sensing the vibrations in the surrounding earth. This allows you to sense any movement that touches the ground within the same Field (as though with a Rank 5 Senses action). Requires at least 1 limb in contact with the ground or a structure

attackBoost.name: Devil Claw Swipe
attackBoost.to: an attack. Can hit spirits and ephemeral beings.

system.techEffect:
Friend of Hell Attitude: You are seen by demons and other evil entities as a friend and ally of Naraka. They may have an individual grievance with you, but it’s more like sibling rivalry than true hostility.

Respire Hellish Breath: You can use any cursed or demonic font of power within the same Field as a Chakra, drawing 3 Prana per Rank into your pool every round.
Deals an additional +1d10 damage if it hits. This slow, powerful thrust is expensive but deadly.

value.name: Move in Time with the Universe

system.techEffect:
While this Mudra is active, your every action is in perfect alignment with cosmic harmony. You do no wrong; axiomatically, you cannot. Add your Effortless attribute to the Rank of all Attacks, Skill actions and Defenses. Your attacks carry the Holy keyword. Any skill you use can operate at the Mystic Tier while you’re so harmonized.

Additionally, reduce the penalty from your Imbalances by
(Achieved Rank).

Finally, you cannot suffer from Disadvantage while this Mudra is active.

The Values above are when used to boost Senses.

Lasts 1 round
system.techReqs: A Deep Understanding of the Undividable Unity of the Universe

system.techEffect: You create and/or command a small blaze of flame equal to (Achieved Rank). You direct this attack like a flamethrower directly after conjuring it; it reverts to its natural physics once you strike a target. The total area covered by the fire is equal to 1 target or a single piece of scenery. Targets struck by this gout of flame catch on fire at (Technique Rank).

Increases an Agility action to move. If used to hide or retreat, additionally creates both an obstacle and Senses action to hide at (Technique Rank). The obstacle congeals out of shadows and lasts until the end of the round; it may be a haze of smoke, a sticky length of webbing, a particularly thick puddle of darkness, or the classic stump with a piece of black cloth draped over it.

You whirl your weapon in a protective arc; what fool would dare to attack you? Foes that attack you suffer counterattack while you’re protected by this Technique. If you choose you may sacrifice its protection against an attacking foe after they strike to deliver an (Achieved Rank) attack against them. Lasts until the end of the round.
You swing your weapon wildly in all directions. This strikes a single foe at (Achieved Rank) and all others in melee range at (Technique Rank).

You unleash a throbbing neon beam of thundering evil at the foe. It moves in a straight line, splitting earth and stone and destroying anything in its path. It reaches the length of a Field, striking any foe in an Area it passes over.

Enemies struck take an additional 3d10 Physical aggravation as their fragile mortal bodies are dissolved.
system.techReqs: Arm or Weapon, Awakened Hell Chakra

system.techEffect: A weaker but less expensive fist strike.
You focus your Prana through your weapon; it emerges in a shrieking neon-pink beam of pure malice. Foes struck take 1d10 Aggravation to a Physical Imbalance in addition to any damage.
A swift, cheap punch

Empty Vessel: Excluding equipment and carried items, you weigh ¼ of what you should for purposes of balancing and leaping (IE: you go 4 times further when you jump and can stand on much more fragile surfaces)

Friend of the Breeze: Any Facing, +1 Rank Agility to move.

Uncatchable Zephyr: Facing 3, +1 Rank to escape grab/entanglement
Balancing on your weapon, you deliver a powerful kick to the enemy’s unfortunate sternum. This attack has Reach and deals +1d10 Damage.
A foe struck by this attack is also Thrown at (Achieved Rank).

Your whirling spear disappears into a flicker of impossible speed, surrounding you in a blur of murderous energy. This defends you as a Shield, presenting certain death to those who dare attempt to strike you. Further, you may launch a free attack at (Technique Rank) against any foe who enters into your weapon’s reach from beyond it. Lasts 1 Round.

You infuse a Subtle weapon with the poisoned wish of death. It hits like a silent sledgehammer. Can empower a ranged or melee attack. If you use Advantage to empower this strike, then it does not count as your single use of Advantage to empower an attack this round.

Once you master this form, you learn the art of devouring the foe’s life-energy as you kill them. For every point of Aggravation you deal to a foe, you gain 1 Prana. Additionally, your grab attacks deal +1d10 Aggravation as
you passively devour the foe’s essence with your merest touch. You may deactivate this power at will.

Launches you as though from an Agility action to move at (Achieved Rank). As you move, you stomp the skulls of any foes you choose within your flightpath: they suffer a single attack at (Achieved Rank). Your flight must be in a reasonably straight line, although you can “wobble” considerably along your route so long as it’s feasible to  keep the kinetic flow of your movement on your trajectory (IE: no leaping through solid obstacles, unless you can smash through them with this attack. Surprise, motherfuckers!)

Squads of foes are decimated by this strike, taking +2d10 damage, while Platoons take +4d10.

Command a sizable body of water within range of your senses, as big as a lake. You may direct it like a tidal wave, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank), but does no damage. Additionally, you may freeze or thaw it; if hardened, it acts as a Field-sized Ice Hazard at the (Achieved Rank), entrapping struck foes.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create a water-based environmental Hazard of (Achieved Rank), although you retain no control of the hazard once unleashed (so you could not stop a tidal wave you cause with this Technique, you’ve got to let it naturally peter out).

The torrents summoned by this use of the Technique are additionally represented by Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank) and remain under your control so long as you Sustain it.
You repay the foe’s clumsy strikes with sharpened steel.
A foe struck by this attack must also resist an (Achieved Rank) trip or fall prone.
You fill the air with Prana-charged bullets. This attack depletes 1d10 additional ammo.

You create and/or command a sizable bonfire of flame equal to (Achieved Rank). You direct this attack like a flamethrower directly after conjuring it; it reverts to its natural physics once you strike a target. The total area covered by the flame is equal to 1 Area and all of the exposed characters and scenery within it. Targets struck by this gout of flame catch on fire at (Achieved Rank).

With an imperious gesture, the practitioner launches a spidery shock of electricity to any foe they can see. This arc of electric energy strikes any target within this Field at (Achieved Rank). In addition, the target is jolted with a (Technique Rank) Electrical Hazard. This bolt may be used to jumpstart electronics if used appropriately within the Tactical Infinity.

Command an enormous body of water within range of your senses, as big as an inland sea. You may direct it like a tsunami, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank); foes swallowed by the waves begin to drown. Additionally, you may freeze or thaw it; if hardened, it acts as a Tract-scale Ice Hazard at (Achieved Rank), entrapping characters, structures and anything else caught in its boundary. You may selectively spare anyone the wrath of the oceans.

The tsunamis summoned by this use of the Technique are additionally represented by Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank X2) and remain under your control so long as you Sustain it.

Your liquid movements evade the enemy and seduce the flame (or vice versa). In addition to the one-time defense benefit, you become entirely resistant to fire-element dangers of all types this round. The resistance effect alone may be Sustained. While within a fire element Hazard, you regain 3 Prana per Rank of Hazard at the end of the round.
Replace your Initiative with (Achieved Rank). Additionally, if you would go before all opponents, creates a single (Achieved Rank) Ranged strike with your weapon. You’re the fastest gun in the land!
A dirt-cheap, versatile strike.

You transform your skin into a stoney outer hide. This provides you with Armor +35 while you sustain the effect. The value in parenthesis is when used to increase Endurance. Nonmagical weapons and ammunition that strike you but fail to do any damage shatter and are destroyed. Barehanded strike which are unreinforced by magic (ie, Techniques) that strike you and fail to do damage deliver 1d10 Aggravation per Rank of the attack to an Imbalance injuring the attacking limb.

The rank is when used to enhance Endurance.
A foe struck by this cruel attack takes an additional +1d10 damage.

Your attack hits like an extinction-meteor, hurling a struck foe as an (Achieved Rank) throw. They impact like an exploding volcano, hitting the impacted spot and sending out a shockwave Hazard over that Field at (Achieved Rank), tripping those who fail to resist it and potentially causing collateral damage as judged in the Tactical Infinity.
In addition to boosting your defense, this Technique creates a (Technique Rank) move action to retreat to nearby cover. If you have Advantage, you can use it to boost this retreat into safety.

A foe struck by this attack is hurled in a direction of your choosing with an (Achieved-Rank) Power action to throw. If they impact any obstacle, it is smashed as though by an (Achieved Rank, +1 for Destructive Keyword) Power action. If they hit a character, that character must defend against an (Achieved Rank) attack, taking attack damage if they fail; they are then thrown to the ground, suffering Disadvantage until they regain their footing.

The thrown foe takes damage as though from a deadly fall each impact (Rank 3), but keeps traveling until they move as though from an (Achieved Rank) Agility action, hit the ground, or hit an obstacle that isn’t destroyed. If any of these impacts result in their death, they burst like a tomato fired from a cannon.

Foes who completely defend against being struck by the thrown foe are not knocked off their feet and arrest the flying character’s freefall. They may “catch” them or let them suffer fall damage, as suits their relationship with the
character.
A foe struck by this attack is hurled backward with an (Achieved Rank) Power action to throw them.

attackBoost.name: Heavy Hit
attackBoost.to: an attack with a Heavy Weapon, addition +1d10 damage if it hits

defenseBoost.name: My Hammer is My Shield
defenseBoost.to: defense as long as you're wielding a Heavy Weapon

system.requirements: a Heavy Weapon or a dire situation
system.techEffect:
Guts and Strife Meditation: You can use enormously heavy weapons, up to a ton in weight (Power Rank 4) with no more effort than a normal person puts into lifting a regular-sized blade. (Remember that this grants +1d10 per Rank required to lift the object, p.12)

Strength Before Thought: Facing 0, +1 Rank to a Power action.

You fill your spear with your fury and hurl it with the force of an artillery shell. It multiplies in flight, raining down in a cascade of glittering edged death. This is a ranged area attack that strikes every foe within a targeted Area.

Platoons and Squads damaged by this attack are pinned by the withering hail of weapons and cannot move unless they overcome a (Technique Rank) obstacle Hazard against their movement.

Adopting the aspect of the perfect silent murderer, you quench any Prana Flare immediately and hide with an (Achieved Rank) Senses action. While hidden, you can leap out from stealth to attack once per round after any participant’s action has concluded and vanish back into hiding before anyone can react. Last until the end of the round.

Focusing your Prana into a fiery orb between your palms, you launch a beam of destructive energy. You can bend and direct this searing plasma-blast; its physics are somewhat similar to a jet of water.

It plows through every person or object you direct it through at (Achieved Rank) until it finally impacts something it can’t utterly destroy, whereupon it explodes in a (Technique Rank) burst that envelops the surrounding Field.

Summon a glistening obsidian weapon of arcane, diabolic design: festooned in glowing runes, it is an artifact of art and blasphemy. You may choose to imbue a weapon with hellish power, rather than summon one.

It has the benefits of up to two different types of weapons ofyour choosing.

In addition, it is infused with any two Novice-level Techniques from this (or another equally hell-aspected) style, which you can use without cost once per round each.

This weapon remains for as long as you will it to remain. You may dismiss it at any time. If it ever entirely leaves your presence, it dissipates into shadow.

Your strike injects the enemy with an overabundance of Wood Prana, causing their body to mutate. Injuries resulting from this attack’s damage manifest as tumorous malformations of flesh and bone, cancerous nodules or other limb-warping maladies: these do not heal naturally and must be corrected by agonizing and dangerous surgery (at a difficulty Rank of the Imbalance +1). These surgeries deal 20 points of Physical Aggravation to the operated-on limb for every 1 Rank they heal.

Masters of the Art of the Doctor can operate without causing any injury.

Leveling your open palm at a foe, you blast them with the fire of Heaven: this manifests as a bolt of golden lightning at (Acheived Rank). After they’re struck, a powerful discharge of secondhand energy arcs into every other foe in their Area, zapping them with a (Technique Rank) electric Metal Hazard. Every element of this attack carries the Holy keyword. Finally, because this is an actual bolt of lightning you’re shooting, it may have additional effects according to the Tactical Infinity as judged by the GM.

You move with the alien grace of a spider skimming across a web. Creates a round-long, sustained defense at (Achieved Rank). In addition, this power allows you to cling to any surface no matter its orientation in space. This lets you climb in any direction with a round-long (Technique Rank) Agility movement action.

You fill the air with bullets and Prana-generated facsimiles thereof, laying waste to a swathe of landscape. Pick a Field you can target with a ranged strike; every enemy and structure present there is struck by this attack. For an additional 12 Prana or an entire clip/quiver of ammunition, you may hit any target a second time with an attack of (Technique Rank). Your reload time is mystically quickened such that you may expend any ammunition within reach towards this attack.
If you completely defend against this strike, you may spring away from the foe with an (Achieved Rank) movement.

Strike every foe within melee range, dealing an additional +2d10 damage. Groups are hit twice and Platoons thrice.

If directed against a single foe, you hit them once at (Achieved Rank) and +4d10 damage and again at (Technique Rank), likely reducing them to jelly.
Foes struck with this Technique are also Tripped at (Achieved Rank).

Creates a shimmering blue barrier of energy, shielding you from attacks. If it is ever breached by an enemy strike, you may choose to have it burst and immerse them in caustic Prana.

When it explodes, it floods out, causing an (Achieved Rank) Caustic Liquid Hazard which floods the Area. The poor sap who burst the shield takes a face full, but other characters might get to higher ground to avoid the flood of burning liquid with a (Technique Rank) Agility action. You and any allies you warn can Effortlessly leap to safety if any is available when the shield bursts.

Increases your Senses action to hide or remain hidden. If your Prana would Flare due to opening Chakra, this Technique can be activated to prevent the blaze. It quashes the light and sound so that you remain silent and inconspicuous.

While utilizing this strange power, you gain the ability to bite and eat metal. Boosts an Endurance action, the Rank of this corresponds to the amount of metal you can eat (use the Power Effect Chart equivalent in lifting). For every Rank you achieve (and subsequently devour in raw metal) you gain +6 Prana.

Rather than gaining Prana, you may expel the ingested metal into the form of a weapon, armor, or metal item of similar complexity; you must have devoured enough metal to produce that item’s mass. You may choose to blend Prana acquisition and item creation.

For item creation purposes, every Prana is roughly equivalent to 1 Metal Resource.
You unbalance the foe with this attack’s deceptive approach. A foe struck by this attack must also resist an (Achieved Rank) trip or fall prone.
Boosts your Agility. You ignore Disadvantage from the terrain you occupy at the start of your movement. Stacks with other Techniques which boost Agility.
Throws the foe in Lieu of damage.

You move in a mystic pattern, tracing a glowing sigil in Prana behind you. This creates a round-long Shield which defends you solely against ranged strikes. You may expend the ambient power of this shield to gain two simultaneous benefits:

1) An Agility action at its Rank to move into cover and
2) Any Expert or weaker Ranged-attack enhancing Technique, which you activate free of initial cost (additional costs required by the Technique must be paid for as normal).
system.techReqs: 2 Legs or Arm and Ranged Weapon

system.techEffect:
You kick or shove with the force of a falling boulder. If you hit against a grabbed foe, they are sent flying up to 1 Field away in a direction of your choosing. The Area they impact suffers an (Achieved Rank) hit as well.

You may direct a thrown foe towards another character, who must defend from an (Achieved Rank) hit. If the strike does damage, they are Tripped at the same Rank.

Rooting your Prana in the eternal energies of the planet, you become an avatar of the green world. This defensive trance protects you as a Shield; you effortlessly dodge, misdirect and endure all dangers. While protected, you ignore all Aggravation resulting from attacks. Additionally, at the end of the round, you heal a single damaged Health level that has at least 1 health point in it completely. Lasts 1 round.

Foes cannot use Techniques to augment either attacks or defenses while within your melee range. They may use a Spirit action higher than (Achieved Rank) or pay 3 Prana per Rank of difference to overcome this restriction (for example, if your Rank is 3 they may perform a Rank 3 Spirit, pay 9 Prana, or do any mix such as Rank 2 and 3 Prana).

This power cannot affect Supreme-level Techniques.

Lasts 1 Round.

You whirl your spear in an impenetrable arc, surrounding yourself in a typhoon of glittering blades. This functions as a Shield, deflecting incoming attacks and answering hostility with your hungry speartip. Lasts for 1 Round

Your blade burns with divine power. You strike every foe in the Field once as your thirsting blade leaps from enemy to enemy. Enemy Squads suffer +3d10 damage from this terrifying strike, while Platoons suffer +5d10

You whirl your weapon in an inescapable vortex of mutilation. Any foe within melee range suffers an attack dealing +3d10 damage. The greater Field also suffers a scouring whirlwind at (Technique Rank), which tears through flesh but leaves terrain intact.

You lash in all directions like a cornered tiger. Every foe within Melee range suffers a single attack. Additionally, you may strike a single unlucky enemy an additional time.

If you lack one of the limbs or weapon necessary to perform this Technique, you may take 1d10 Physical Aggravation per missing limb or weapon to use it anyway.

This Technique allows you to reach out and manipulate physical objects with your mind. It has many permutations.

When used to enhance a Power action, this Technique allows you to lift objects within range at (Achieved Rank) with the power of your mind alone.

Used as a Defense, you anticipate an attack and pull yourself to safety with an invisible force of will.

After you have mastered this disquieting Mudra, you may use it without cost for one of two useful effects: First, you can use psychic force to manipulate objects within the same Field and range of your senses without cost at Power Rank 1.

Second, you can lift yourself and hover or fly with this Technique, although you move no faster than jogging speed (Agility Rank 1).

Either the self-lifting or Power action uses may be sustained.

You fill a single Subtle weapon with so much malice that it multiplies in flight, becoming a glittering hail of deadly blades. Although you throw only a single weapon, dozens or hundreds land. You strike every foe outside of cover and every piece of terrain within the targeted Field as your hailstorm of shuriken crash into everything. The multiplied weapons remain as a Hazard after being thrown at (Technique Rank); those who move through them are sliced and gouged by the field of bladed death.

You strike a single foe with a powerful two-handed sword cleave at (Achieved Rank). Additionally, you carry the strike through as a cyclone of edged death, striking every enemy within melee range at the (Technique Rank).

You envelope the entire Field surrounding you in an anti-prana stasis bubble. The Techniques of foes will not function unless they pay a surcharge of 5 Prana per tier of the Technique (5 for Novice, 10 for Expert, 15 for Master). 
You gain all Prana spent on these surcharges while the stasis field lasts.

This surcharge does not apply to Supreme-level Techniques; if one is used within the stasis field, it burns the field away.

Lasts 1 round unless Sustained. Your (Achieved Rank) acts the Rank of this Hazard. A character overcome its effects with an equal or higher-Ranked Spirit action.

Upon learning this Mudra, you become immortal. You will never grow old nor die, though you can be injured or sickened. You cannot die from damage to your body, but if torn apart you are effectively incapacitated until your head and organs are reunited and your Chakra properly aligned. If less than decapitated, you revive in 1d10 days. If your frame is annihilated beyond restructuring, you are reborn from a stone egg somewhere within the boundaries of the Tract where you died.

The Values above are when used to boost a Spirit action.
system.techReqs: Transcendant Understanding of your Eternal Nature

system.techEffect: You become as insubstantial as a ghost and as unobtrusive as a needle dipped in poison. Generates a Shield as a protective, tenebrous cloak at (Achieved Rank) and allows you to move away from an attacker as an Agility action of the same Rank if they fail to injure you. While you make this move, you are ghostly and can move through solid objects. This shadow cloak also conceals you with an (Achieved Rank) Hide action if you are in an unoccupied Area at the end of any movement.

You summon a ball of lightning to hurl at your foes. Hits a single target at (Achieved Rank), then explodes, causing a Field-wide electrical Metal Hazard at (Technique Rank). You may spare your allies from these effects.

After defending against an attack, this Technique increases your Effortless Defense by 1 Rank against ranged strikes this turn. This effect is Sustainable. You may sacrifice this protection to increase an Agility action to move to cover by (Achieved Rank).
This skillful riposte can either disarm or trip your foe.
You reach out and attack with a tendril of invisible psychic force. This is both Ranged and Subtle as it is an invisible, silent and essentially unpredictable attack from an impossible angle.

You evoke a powerful shield of shearing winds. Attacks from long range must overcome this defense as normal. Attackers within melee range don’t face the shield effect, but instead are pushed and thrown prior to their strike connecting. If they can’t overcome the push effect at (Achieved Rank) with Agility or Endurance then they’re sent flying as though from a throw. Lasts 1 round.

This disorienting defense prevents a foe from using Advantage to increase the attack that it is defending against. Since they declare that before your declare defense, “refund” their invocation of Advantage and reduce the Rank of their attack by 1.

You attack in an unconventional manner. This slightly weak attack is unpredictable and versatile; it doesn’t require traditional limbs or weapons and in fact, cannot even use them to injure the foe. Can be used to empower a melee or ranged strike: It’s just got to be weird.
system.techReqs: Non-limb body part or weird tool

system.techEffect:
Command a small body of water within range of your senses, as big as a pond. You may direct it like a fire hydrant, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank), but does no damage. Additionally, you may freeze or thaw an Area’s worth of it; if hardened, it acts as an Ice Hazard at (Achieved Rank), potentially entrapping struck foes.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create a water-based environmental Hazard of (Achieved Rank), although you retain no control of the hazard once unleashed (so you could not stop a tidal wave you cause with this Technique, you’ve got to let it naturally peter out).
This precise strike requires intense concentration, but is usable in a variety of circumstances.

You generate a small army of shadowy clones of yourself, seven per awakened Chakra. They each act as a 1-Effort Disciple, acting on your initiative. You can arrange them into Squads or larger Platoons if you have enough. You can channel your Techniques through any individual clone, temporarily empowering them. Additionally, you can transfer your full consciousness and powers into any clone, although your possessions remain with your original body.

The clones last until the end of the turn, when they dissolve back into shadow.If sustained, the clones last until the end of the scene. You may only invoke one instance of this
Technique at a time.
If you damage a foe, you may spend another Effort die to add +4 damage. You can make this trade once per Effortless Rank.

reates a sustained, round-long Defense. You exist in psychic harmony with your surroundings, perfectly harmonizing with the psychic ambiance. This provides you with near-perfect clairvoyance and reflexes to avoid danger, including attacks.

While so harmonized, you add 1 Prana into your Pool for every 3 Prana spent on Techniques used to attack you. If you annul a Technique targeting you, then you gain 1 Prana for every 3 wasted by the enemy. Round up in all cases.

When the Senses boosting capability is used to hide, this technique hides you from the mind’s eye; you’re simply not noticed by those around you, made invisible by their subconscious refusal to acknowledge your presence.

system.requirements: an arm and a Ranged Weapon
system.techEffect:
Cultivate Cover: Facing 0, +1 Agility to move into Cover.

Sniper’s Attitude: You may use Advantage on ranged strikes.

Traps all foes within this Field within the pattern of your attacks. If they move from their current position, they suffer an (Achieved Rank) attack. If the moving foe is within this Field but beyond your natural reach, this maneuver gives you the option to immediately and effortlessly move to any position that allows you to reach them as though moving with an (Achieved Rank) Agility action. This movement occurs out-of-sequence from your normal actions during the turn and looks completely awesome and a little eerie. Lasts 1 Round.

system.description:
Your body is completely paralyzed, your muscles tensed into unresponsive lumps. Your limbs act as though you’re catatonic, remaining as they’re posed by others. You can’t take any active action nor move; you’re immobile and rooted to the spot, unable to attack or act (although you can still speak). Although you can defend yourself, you must describe your defenses in terms of your paralysis; flopping unresponsive limbs, seized joints, spastic movements, etc. In addition, you have Disadvantage while paralyzed.

In the round in which you first receive this Imbalance, you may spend Effort equal to its Rank to retain your freedom of movement. If you do not, you must take the crippling Dramatic effect!

If the Rank of this Imbalance ever exceeds your remaining Health, it becomes a Deadly Physical Imbalance as your body rips itself apart in a shower of explosive organ failure. Any being of Degree 0 simply explodes if the Imbalance ever exceeds their remaining Health Levels.

Special Rule:

Nonliving Targets

The Aggravation generated from this style affects the living, the dead, and inanimate objects equally. It targets the cosmic wavelengths that flow through everything, disrupting, blocking and mutilating them with its incredible killing power.

Undead or ghostly targets struck take Imbalances just like living ones. Inanimate objects receive the Imbalance, but it manifests differently. Any practitioner of this style, or anyone chosen by a practitioner, adds the Rank of the Prana Catastrophe Imbalance carried by the object to their attacks and Power actions to cause damage to the object.

system.techEffect:
Create and/or command a massive wave of flame equal to (Achieved Rank). You direct this attack like a flamethrower directly after conjuring it, but it reverts to its natural physics once you strike a target. The total area covered by the flame is up to 1 Field, its external or internal structures and all exposed inhabitants. The heat of the fire is based on the Rank of Effect you achieve. Targets struck by this gout of flame catch on fire at (Achieved Rank).

Your firestorm is represented by Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank) and remains under your control so long as you Sustain it.
You redirect and evade the foe’s attack, snapping back at them like a bamboo reed in a high wind.
system.techReqs: Arm and Reflexive Weapon or 2 Legs

attackBoost.name: Hornet Diplomacy
attackBoost.to: an attack with a Reach Weapon

defenseBoost.name: Reprimand of Steel
defenseBoost.to: defense when wielding a Reach Weapon

system.techEffect:
Weave the Iron Web: So long as you are within weapon’s reach of any foe and none are within melee range of you, add +5 to your Initiative.

Rootbreaker Strategy: Facing 0, an Area within reach of your weapon becomes Disadvantage-causing terrain equal to (Achieved Rank) until the end of the round.

Traps a single foe you can reach within the pattern of your attacks. If they move from their current position, they suffer an (Achieved Rank) attack. You may activate this against multiple foes, but each use must be paid for and Sustained individually. Lasts 1 Round.

You spin your weapon in a blur of motion, deflecting attacks and punishing anyone foolish enough to strike you. If you would go first in the initiative order in a given round, you may choose to go last; if you do so, increase the defense offered by this Technique by 1 Rank and it sustains this round without using a Focus Slot.

Lasts 1 round.

Saluting Heaven, you channel the cosmos’ divine fury into a single finger, launching it at your foe as a throbbing ray of incandescent Prana. It hits its target at (Achieved Rank) (or nearby if they dodge), drilling through and ignoring any armor or intervening terrain. It bursts at the point of impact, causing a secondary explosion that billows out to affect that Field at (Technique Rank) and the surrounding Tract at Rank 5. All of these strikes carry the Holy Keyword, and the entire tract is cleansed of any wicked energies or curse as Heaven’s flames cascade over everything. This attack and it’s subsequent effects are extensions of your will, and selectively spare anyone or anything you so choose from your fury; they experience the attack and its fallout as a warm, sunlight-filled breeze.
The skill of the greatest swordmasters is for naught if they never survive a duel. This solid defense is founded on millennia of defensive drills.

Command a small gust of air within range of your senses. You may direct it like a breeze, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank), as a Power action, but does no damage (although thrown objects deal damage as normal). Additionally, you may lift yourself with it, floating and flying as an Agility action of (Achieved Rank). This effect is Sustainable

You send out a destructive wave of psychic force, crushing and mutilating everything in this Area and all neighboring ones (Achieved Rank). All terrain and characters, save yourself, in the affected areas are crushed by your attack, as though from a calamitous sudden increase in gravity. You cannot spare your allies; this deadly attack is indiscriminate.

If the raw Power of the attack is sufficient to damage the scenery, a new Area is created based on your act of destruction.
system.techReqs: Awakened Metal Chakra or Two Arms and One other Chakra

system.techEffect: Focusing your Prana in your skull, you ram it into the foe like a hammer.

You evoke the Seven Divine Venoms from your own Chakra, infusing your body, weapons and soul with their insidious energy. For every Awakened Chakra, you may produce a distinct type of Divine Venom.

Once per turn, you may imbue any bodily fluid with one of these poisons, or infuse it into a held weapon. You are also totally immune to lesser poisons; your soul is the standard against which poison is judged.

You can reproduce any poison that you’ve ingested. In addition to reproducing these poisons, you may produce their antidotes (both temporary and permanent)

The Divine Venoms are Virulence 12 and last until cured. A character may only be poisoned by one of these twelve terrible venoms at a time; they cancel one another out due to their elementally-opposed nature.

Cosmic: Outer Darkness Venom
Characters poisoned with this can no longer spend or accumulate Kharma.

Metal: Demiurge Bile
This poison annihilates higher thought; characters cannot use Intellect over Rank 0 when affected.

Wood: Dying Dragon Curse
Characters poisoned with this cannot heal or generate prana from their Chakra.

Air: Blood-to-Stone Poison
Characters poisoned with this cannot move more gracefully than Agility 0. If they cease moving for more than 1 hour, they turn to stone until the poison is extracted.

Fire: Rakshasa’s Shadow
Poisoned characters gradually lose their physical bodies. Once per day, they lose a single Effort die to the spirit realm; once none are remaining, their body is completely transmuted into spiritual matter and they must reside within (and obey the laws of) the spirit world.

Water: Dragon Turtle Barb
Poisoned with this awful venom, the character slowly transforms into a monster. Their Effort is replaced by Ferocity, one per day, until they’ve degenerated into a completely bestial state. When their final Effort is lost, they become ravenous beasts, losing their personality and memories and rampaging across the world as a frothing berserker.

Earth: Tiger Cannibal Froth
When poisoned, the subject can only draw nourishment by eating fresh human flesh.

The ranks above are only for when boosting senses.
Infusing your first with the weight of a stone and killing power of a sledgehammer, you deal the enemy a punishing blow. Alternatively, you wreak havoc on the landscape with your mighty fist.

Enhances Hand-to-Cannon Sutra - costs given above are only used when boosting agility.

Whenever you transform devoured metal into a weapon, it can now transform your gun, hand and arm into a weapon of cosmic might; the entire appendage morphs into a baroque and artful weapon with a burning miniature star of pure Prana searing visibly within its alien architecture. This awe-inspiring cannon can be used to launch a beam of concentrated good or evil for the cost in brackets.

(100): Moon-Cracking Beam: Unleash an attack Rank +7, Facing 6-9 beam of blinding energy which sears through everything until it hits a Tract-scale obstacle or the curvature of the planet and detonates, causing an (Achieved Rank) explosion in the Field struck and a (Technique Rank) fallout disaster in that Tract. In addition to injuring mortal persons and structures, this holy disaster injures spirits, elementally misaligned scenery or Unholy beings. This cleanses the Tract of unholy energies, leaving it pure (If somewhat decimated)

(100): Hell’s Artillery: You arc a meteorically massive attack, Rank+ 7 Facing 0-3 bombshell at any target you can see. It explodes on impact, vaporizing the Field in which it lands at (Achieved Rank) and causing a nuclear, cursed fallout at (Technique Rank) covering the entire Tract. Corpses within the fallout are transformed into Atomic Jiangshi if they are over 100 years old.

Infusing a dart, shuriken, kunai or other Subtle weapon with your killing intent, you hurl it into the foe’s vulnerable flesh like the fang of an asp. If you apply Poison to this weapon, you succeed automatically and there is no chance of poisoning yourself.

First Among Equals: Roll 2d10 for initiative, choose 1 result.

Heaven’s Glare: Facing 0; +1 Rank Senses-based action: blind a single foe in this Field with light reflected from your blade, giving them Disadvantage this round. They can defend, or resist with Endurance or Senses.

You evade the foe’s strikes as easily as the eagle avoids the snake. If you’re caught in an area-affecting strike, you move such that your final position puts you safe from any danger of fallout (unless this is impossible).

Your body bakes with heat as you externalize the spirit of the Rakshasa. This creates a shimmering Shield of heat and energy around you. While this barrier endures, you become entirely resistant to fire-element dangers of all types.

While within the same Field as or inside of a Fire Hazard, you regain 6 Prana per Rank of the Hazard.

Finally, your body radiates a Rank 5 Fire hazard within any Area you occupy (you cannot absorb the Prana from your own heat, but any fires which erupt as a result of your heat can be drawn upon).

You grab a foe with your psychic powers. They appear to freeze in place while you levitate and restrict them. This works like a normal Grab attack, but doesn’t require any limbs. You can move the held foe three dimensionally in space while they stay within range of your senses, moving slowly at an effective Agility of 0.

Infuses a strike with harmful vibrations. For this round and as long as it is Sustained, you may deal Aggravation rather than damage with any attack. This may generate or inflame a Prana Catastrophe Imbalance.

You launch your spear into the sky, charging it with murderous power. It explodes and rains down as a shower of countless duplicates. This is a ranged area attack that strikes every enemy within a single Field within range of your senses.

Platoons and Squads targeted by this attack are pinned by the withering hail of weapons and cannot move unless they overcome a (Technique Rank) obstacle Hazard against their movement. Should they attempt to do so and fail, they lose 1d10 members per Squad or 3d10 members per Platoon due to panic and desertion.

With surgical accuracy, you strike the foe’s secret pressure points, causing an internal disaster! Rather than Damage, this strike deals Aggravation towards a Prana Catastrophe Imbalance. If it deals Aggravation to a foe, increase it by +5d10.

Special: Once you learn this Technique, you enhance your ability to inflict the Prana Catastrophe Imbalance. Now, if the foe is paralyzed by the Dramatic penalty, you may puppeteer them and cause them to take actions. You can make them take one Rank 0 action one per 2 Effort (or equivalent) they possess.They act on your Initiative.
This clumsy but ferocious attack deals an additional +3d10 damage if it connects.
An inexpensive kick attack. Can be used to trip a foe. If so used, instead of dealing damage, they’re knocked down and gain Disadvantage from being winded.

You don’t bother to dodge or block strikes; you just endure them. While protected by this Technique, you do not lose consciousness if you lose all Health due to damage. Additionally, you do not die if an Imbalance reaches Rank 10. Nor do you die for any other reason, although you may reach a point of bodily damage at which nothing short of the miracle of this Technique can keep you in the mortal coil.

While you’re protected by this persistent defense, you can choose to take Aggravation rather than Health Damage from attacks.

This defense additionally protects you against poison, disease and environmental hazards.

Lasts until the end of the round unless sustained, in which case, lasts until you’re finished spitting in the eye of god.

You telekinetically crush all foes and all terrain you choose to target within this Field. This shockwave of force is selective and can spare your allies.

When used to boost Power, it allows you to lift, shape and otherwise interact with things purely through your Telekinesis (as the Technique of the same name); you may affect any object you can perceive.
system.techReqs: Awakened Metal Chakra or Two Arms and One other Chakra

system.techEffect:
Command a small amount of water within range of your senses. You may direct it like a fire hydrant, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank), but does no damage. Additionally, you may relinquish control over it by freezing it; it hardens as an Ice Hazard at (Achieved Rank), potentially entrapping a struck foe.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create a water-based environmental Hazard of (Achieved Rank), although you retain no control of the hazard once unleashed (so you could not stop a whirlpool you cause with this Technique, you’ve got to let it naturally peter out).

Glowing with internal energy, masters of this form shrug off even the deadliest of attacks: truly, they are indestructible! If you fail to completely defend against an attack with this Technique, reduce any resulting aggravation received by 5d10. Ignore any additional injurious effect of an attack that strikes you; you cannot be poisoned, caught on fire, even shoved. You take no additional Aggravation from Techniques that increase the amount of Aggravation they deal.

The protections offered by this Technique are all Sustainable, including a (Technique Rank) bonus to defense. Last until the end of the Round.
A versatile defense, usable with any free limb.

You simply absorb the foe’s attack, gritting your teeth and bearing through the pain. Rather than pay the Prana cost of this Technique, you can voluntarily take 1d10 damage and pay for it in your own flesh.

Against any character you can sense, you disrupt and annul the use of a Technique. They may pay 3 additional Prana to push it through despite your interference. If they cannot or do not, the Technique fails to function and the Prana used to power it is wasted. Master and Supreme-Level Techniques cannot be disrupted.

The values in parenthesis are when used to boost Intellect.

You strike the foe’s secret pressure-points, filling the Prana meridians with destructive vibrations. Rather than damage, this strike creates Aggravation towards a Prana Catastrophe Imbalance. If it deals Aggravation to a foe, increase the amount by +3d10.
Using your weapon as a shield, you blunt the foe’s attack.

You can command any earth-aligned substance.

You can reshape earth as though it were water or stone as
though it were clay.

You needn’t physically interact with the substance to affect it; any earth or stone you can see is shapeable so long as you are standing on the same ground that it occupies. 

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create an earth or stonebased environmental Hazard of (Achieved Rank), although you retain no control of the hazard once unleashed (so you could not stop an avalanche you cause with this Technique, you’ve got to let it naturally peter out). Such Hazards include deep chasms, rockslides, minor earthquakes, sandstorms, and other dangerous phenomena.

When you master this savage meditation, you learn to ingest Prana from the meat of your enemies. Whenever you deal a Health Level of damage to a foe, you gain +1d10 Prana. You also gain this Prana if you devour an entire heart, limb, or organ of an equivalent amount of meat or blood. Typical humans have about 24 Prana worth of such meat on their bodies. Each size category bigger doubles that amount, while each smaller halves it. Bon appétit!

As you dodge your foe’s strike, you become temporarily immaterial and retreat to safety. In addition to defense, you move away with an (Achieved Rank) Agility action, moving through any physical objects in your way. If you conclude your movement in suitable terrain, you may attempt to hide at (Achieved Rank) as you vanish from sight.

You move with such uncanny speed, it appears you are in multiple places at once. Strike every foe in the same Field as you. Squads take an additional hit and are dealt +3d10 damage on any hit. Platoons take 2 additional hits and receive a horrific +5d10 damage per hit.

If you turn the fury of this attack on a single target, you strike them once at (Achieved Rank) and additionally strike them once per open Chakra at (Technique Rank).

When used for defense, lasts for the entire round and allows you to redirect any melee-ranged attack that you completely defend against to another foe within that range. It strikes them at the (Achieved Rank) the foe acquired.

The defense aspect of this Technique is Sustainable.
So long as you have the use of your lower body, you can use this superior defense to blunt and redirect the kinetic force of the foe’s attacks with your hypnotic, undulating movements

Your aura flares into a fountain of celestial light and spinning wheels of eyes. This functions as a Shield of (Achieved Rank). In addition to searing those aligned to Naraka as Hero’s Halo, this shield electrocutes those who fail to overcome its defense (represented by the Counterattack keyword). Lasts until the End of the Round.

Creates an annihilating orb of whiteness that expands to encompass the Tract. Hits terrain and people, but also cleanses any psychic or mystical residue, including curses, prophecies, and unhallowed ground. All is returned to its pure, atomic origin by this universe-scouring event.

The immediate Field is struck at (Achieved Rank), while the surrounding Tract endures a (Technique Rank) strike.

It annihilates and pulverizes structures, reducing them to atoms. Individuals can be selectively spared, teleported to any area within or up to 1 Field outside of the affected area
at your choosing. You may extend your mercy to as many recipients as you choose.

Due to its cosmic nature, this Technique is one of the very few methods that can bring true and final death to an Immortal.
If you deal damage to the foe, they must overcome a (Technique Rank) attempt to trip them or they fall prone and suffer Disadvantage.
You defend yourself with Prana-reinforced arm blocks. If you totally prevent a melee-range attack with this defense, you may lock the foe’s striking limb into a Grab.

You have fused your body and spirit into a perfect engine of battle. While this Technique is active, it allows you to use any Novice-level Technique that requires a limb or weapon free of cost, up to a number of times equal to (Achieved Rank). Your action may be combined with Mastery of Spirit or other benefits that increase the Rank of a Spirit action.

If you suffer Aggravation, or if an enemy overcomes your (Achieved Rank) action with a Spirit action of their own, the harmony of your form is disrupted and the effect ends. Unfortunately for your foes, enemies wishing to disrupt you must do so within melee range; distant spiritual curses are too wimpy to stop your mighty onslaught!

Lasts 1 Round.
Grab and clinch a foe with this crippling nerve-strike.

You assume the form of a terrible, primal god. This has the following effects:

● Your Effort doubles but becomes Ferocity.

● You may use Ferocity for any Physical skill or Senses.

● Your body turns into a four-legged, savage monster (Size 8). You are as big as an elephant and can swallow enemies whole (Grab Rank 7, Rank 5 ongoing damage as you digest them) once per round.

● Your Effortless Power and Endurance become Rank 8. Additionally, while transformed, your Power, Endurance, Agility and Senses actions may all naturally reach Rank 14+.

● Your Health doubles.

● You may activate up to 2 Master-level or weaker Techniques from this style free of cost once per round.

● You may discharge an injured limb, ridding yourself of weakness; it becomes a Beast-Tier (12 Ferocity, size 5) natural creature under your control.

● The severed limb regenerates, healing 1 Rank per round until the original Imbalance is fully healed and it regrows.

● If your head is severed, you may have it launch one final strike at (Rank 8) at any time later during this or the proceeding Scene to avenge you.

This transformation lasts for 1 Round per Degree you’ve achieved. Afterward, it requires 50 Prana per round to sustain. Animals spawned from your body remain loyal Disciples.
You jab the foe with this inexpensive, precision nervestrike.
Increases your Initiative; treat your result as the total of your bid. Once during this round, if you attack a foe before they’ve acted, you place them at Disadvantage.

Surrounds you in a shield of twisting Pranic tendrils. In addition to the benefits of counterattack, you may strike foes entering or remaining in melee range with a (Technique Rank) attack, lashing them with your energy-tentacles. Lasts 1 round.

value.name: Pierce the Heart of the World

system.techEffect: You blast a torrent of searing neon pink, utterly annihilating all in its path. It moves in a straight line, demolishing everything in the Fields it passes through as it reaches to the far end of this Tract. Enemies struck take an additional 5d10 Physical Aggravation. Left in its wake is a burned-out trench in the planet, 100’ deep.

When used to attack, strikes every foe within arm’s reach. If there is only a single foe, it hits them 3 times. Hits Squads twice and deals +1d10 damage each time it hits, and Platoons thrice for +3d10 damage each time.

When used for defense, it lasts for the entire round and allows you to redirect any melee-ranged attack that you completely defend against to another foe within that range. It strikes them at the (Achieved Rank) the foe acquired.

This Mudra shrouds you in subtlety and darkness. It creates and sustains a Senses action to hide, additionally suppressing the blaze from opening your Chakra. Both the hide and Prana-shrouding effect lasts until the end of the round and are Sustainable.

Strikes a single foe at full effect and additionally strikes 1 additional time at (Technique Rank) per Awakened Chakra. Any enemy in melee range can be targeted by these secondary strikes. Foes damaged by this attack lose 1d10 Prana per successful strike as you twist and innervate their Chakra meridians.

Your blow falls with the weight of the universe. The Tract in which you unleash this attack quakes under a 40 Cataclysm-Die Disaster that manifests like an earthquake. This is a miraculous quake, and you choose how the destruction from this one-time Disaster manifests, so long as your chosen manifestation is arguably in line with a giant earthquake.

Alternatively, you can cancel up to 40 Cataclysm dice which would be rolled against your wishes. Your blow counterbalances and cancels any lesser apocalypse.
This beastly leg strike brings the pain, dealing an additional +1d10 damage if it lands.

Subconscious Whisper: You can broadcast your thoughts into the mind of another character. If they so choose, you can hear the thoughts they broadcast in return. You must otherwise be able to sense your target for this power to function.

Adds to your Endurance against an energy-based Hazard (Metal and Fire are always energy-based, others may be as well according to the Tactical Infinity). If used against heat or fire-based hazards, you gain an additional Rank of protection and respire 1d10 Prana.

Against any character you can sense, you disrupt and annul the use of a Technique. Master-level Techniques can be pushed through for the additional cost of 12 Prana. If they cannot or do not pay the additional cost, the Technique fails to function and the Prana used to power it is wasted. Supreme-level Techniques cannot be disrupted.

The values in parenthesis are when used to boost Intellect.

You weave and dance out of the range of enemy strikes in a hypnotic rhythm, creating an (Achieved Rank) persistent defense. You can sacrifice this defense to generate an (Achieved Rank) Agility action to move or Senses action to hide.

If you lack one of the limbs necessary to perform this Technique, you may take 1d10 Physical Aggravation per missing limb to use it anyway.

Lasts 1 Round

Enhances a grab attempt, or enhances the attempt to
crush a held foe.

You hurl your spear so hard and so far that it transcends the fragile three dimensions that contain perceivable reality. It and you weave through and redefine the dimensions of the surrounding Tract. If anyone moves within the Tract and you do not wish them to, you may strike them with an (Achieved Rank) attack. At your leisure, you may follow your speartip to their side and ignore the distance between your current position and your new one. Lasts one round
Strike a primary target at (Achieved Rank) and every other foe in the same area at (Technique Rank). This empties your clip/chambers if using a gun, or quiver if using arrows.

Also known as the “Punarmrityu Descent”

Battened on dark Prana, your form swells into that of a hideous dark god, bulging with iron-hard muscle. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:

● You gain Ferocity equal to your Effort. These additions to your Effort may not be used for anything aside from attacks, defenses, or acts of mindless savagery, but otherwise combine freely (it’s best to roll them separately or use different-colored dice).
● You may activate any one Master-level or weaker Technique which carries the Unholy keyword or that requires an Awakened non-Heaven Chakra without paying its cost once per round.
● You gain additional Aura equal to your current Health. This manifests as a demonic halo of energy.
● Your Effortless Rank increases by 1.
● Whenever someone dies in your presence, you immediately gain +1d10 Prana plus an additional 10 for every Degree they’ve achieved.
● While transformed, your Skill actions are no longer capped. If you are able to achieve a Rank 14+ result, then you act at your Achieved Rank.

This transformation lasts for 1 Round per Degree you’ve achieved. Afterward, it requires 50 Prana per round to
sustain. 

The value in parentheses is used when increasing Spirit.

You evoke an invincible aegis of divine wind. Attacks from range which are completely blunted by your shield are redirected at another target of your choice.

Attacks from melee range instead push and throw foes prior to their strike connecting. If they can’t overcome the push effect at (Achieved Rank) with Agility or Endurance then they’re sent flying as though from a throw. Additionally, foes within melee range suffer a cold Hazard of (Technique Rank) from the freezing winds. Lasts 1 round.

Roll a d10 to determine the Facing of the strike; pairs with like-Facings. If you cannot launch a 1-die attack and cannot pair it with another die to make a bonus action, your Prana is wasted and the Technique fails.
system.techReqs: Head, shoulder, teeth, or some other dirty tactic

system.techEffect: You bear your evil and the universe trembles. Increases your Spirit, but cannot be used for any purpose which benefits others more than yourself.

Clapping your hands before your fiery Heaven Chakra, you surround yourself in an aura of shining, golden sigils. This creates a Holy Shield of (Achieved Rank).

Additionally, the Shield acts as a Fire Hazard of (Achieved Rank) against any creature tainted by Naraka that comes within melee range. Unfortunately, this includes such nonevil creatures as mutants, psychics, and others whose nature is circumstantially opposed by Heaven’s energy.
This prickly defense redirects a foe’s strike and opens them for a swift jab of steel to the belly, forearm, or other carelessly exposed body part.

Traps every foe in a single Area your weapon can reach within the pattern of your attacks. If they move from their current position, they suffer an (Achieved Rank) attack. You may change the target Area of this maneuver at the beginning of the round if Sustained. Lasts 1 Round
Linking your Prana meridians to the living soil below, you channel the world’s energy through your weapon; your strike hits like a falling boulder.

You launch yourself to any Area within the same Field. Any foe in your targeted Area, or any foe in your direct path between your launching point and that field, suffers a single attack from this deadly kick attack. If you strike an object that cannot be damaged by your attack, your movement ends there.
You infuse your physical form with a gush of adrenaline and psychic energy, enhancing an attack or a defense.

Summon and command a tornado of air to surround and uplift you like a vengeful wind-god. This enveloping whirlwind encircles the Field directly beneath you in (Achieved Rank) hurricane-level force, uprooting trees, hurling broom straws through stumps, and demolishing manmade structures. The rest of the Tract is subject to (Technique Rank) winds. These catastrophic winds are represented by Cataclysm dice equal to (Achieved Rank X2) that remain under your control for the duration of the
Technique.

You may direct your full focus and use your wind-mastery to push, freeze or create a vacuum in a single Field within the area of effect at (Achieved Rank) once per turn.

You have total mastery over what is subjected to the passive or active fury of the winds and what is spared and may revoke your mercy at any time.

While commanding the gales, you can fly anywhere within the boundary of your storm effortlessly with a (Technique Rank) Agility movement once per turn.

A foe struck by this attack is hurled backward with an (Achieved Rank) Power action to throw. If they impact any obstacle, it is smashed as though your attack targeted it directly and they take damage as from a deadly fall (a Rank 3 strike, p.14). If they hit a character, that character must defend as though your attack targeted them and takes attack damage if they fail; the thrown character still takes falling damage.

Command a small cyclone of air within range of your senses. You may direct it, retaining control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank), as a Power action, but does no damage (although thrown objects deal damage as normal).

Instead of creating a gust of wind, you may lift yourself with a sphere of air, floating and flying as an Agility action of (Achieved Rank); this also creates a shield of wind at (Achieved Rank), protecting you while increasing your movement. This Shield only protects against ranged strikes.These effects are Sustainable.

Create and command an apocalyptic cascade of flame equal to (Achieved Rank). You direct this attack like a flamethrower directly after conjuring it, but it reverts to its natural physics once you strike a target. The total area covered by the flame is equal to 1 primary Field and its surrounding Tract and everything contained within it. The Field primarily targeted by this attack is struck by this gout of flame catches on fire at (Achieved Rank), while the remainder of the Tract burns at (Technique Rank).

Your firestorm is represented by Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank X2) and remains under your control so long as you Sustain it.
Deals an additional 1d10 damage from a punishing heavy punch.
While you hold a spear in your hands, you are unassailable.

attackBoost.name: Velvet Execution
attackBoost.to: an attack with a Subtle Weapon

system.requirements: some darkness or shadow in the environment.
system.techEffect:
Friend of the Dark: Facing 9, +1 to a Senses action to hide.

Breath of Midnight: After you have joined combat, the automatic once-per-round opening of your Chakra does not cause you to Prana Flare or render stealth impossible.
Grab and strangle a foe. Deals an additional 1d10 Physical Aggravation every round you maintain your chokehold as you crush their life out.

Ajna Sight: You perceive the flow of energy with your Ajna Chakra. You sense electric currents, combustion, or anything which you can reasonably argue is a flow of energy (no potential energy, you pedants). Counts as a Rank 5 Senses action to do so.
Increases your strength enormously. Stacks with other effects that increase Power, including other Techniques if Infused.

You enter a carnivorous trance, feasting on the enemy’s life energy as you tear their body apart. Every time you increase the Rank of a Physical Imbalance suffered by the foe, you immediately gain +6 Prana. Additionally, you may consume your own flesh to gain mystic energy: a number of times per round equal to your Effortless attribute, you may suffer +1d10 Physical Aggravation to gain +6 Prana. Last until the end of the round.

The ranks above are to boost Spirit.
system.techReqs: A mouthful of flesh, blood or bone

system.techEffect: Focusing your Prana into your weapon, you unleash a powerful ranged attack.

This Technique defends at (Achieved Rank), then things get interesting. In response to an attack, you transform your body into a swarm of vermin; rats, roaches, bats or some other unwholesome creatures. Your new body has Ferocity equal to twice your current Health Levels, but cannot use any Techniques or Gupt Kala. Your equipment transforms with you.

You can split the swarm into multiple swarms by dividing the Ferocity among them. You can reassume your natural form out of any of the swarms you wish at any time, but you only have Health equal to half of that swarm’s Ferocity.
Friend of the Sea: You breathe water as easily as air. Additionally, you swim as naturally and effortlessly as a dolphin in water (Effortless Agility 4 swim movement).
You batter the foe’s attack away with mongoose-quick blocks.

You can command any earth-aligned substance.

You can reshape earth and stone as though it were water. You need only be capable of sensing the earth-element substance to command it and need not touch it.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. It can also be used to create an earth or stonebased environmental Disaster of (Achieved Rank). This mighty manifestation gains Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank) and remains under your control so long as you Sustain it.

Such Disasters include earth-rending canyons, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, flesh-scouring sandstorms, and other nightmarishly dangerous phenomena.
This vicious strike deals an additional 2d10 Physical Aggravation when it deals damage.
Summon a dim, ghostly orb of psychic energy and hurl it towards the foe. It acts as a ranged, energy attack.

If you’re attacking before your foe’s Initiative, then this technique costs 1 less prana. Additionally, this attack does not trigger the Counterattack keyword, nor can it be interfered with by a Prana-Drain keyworded ability.
A braced, mighty leg-strike. Deals a whopping +2d10 Damage if it hits.

You make a mockery of your foe’s attempts to harm you. If you completely defend against the foe’s attack, you roll them over your hip or shoulders and flip them into their back, Tripping them. Additionally, they’re winded from their tumble and take Disadvantage for the remainder of the round.

You can command any earth-aligned substance.

You can reshape earth and stone as though it were water. You need only be capable of sensing the earth-element substance to command it and need not touch it.

This power can be used to attack or defend, depending on how it is used. You can instead cause an Earthquake-scale Disaster affecting any Tract you can sense (so long as solid earth rests below it) of (Achieved Rank). This mighty manifestation gains Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank X2) and remains under your control so long as you Sustain it.

Such Disasters include bottomless pits opening in the tormented earth, volcanic eruptions that level cities, extinction-event earthquakes, Rains of burning stone and rock, and similar apocalyptic phenomena.

You ascend to divinity, at least temporarily.

● Your Effort doubles.

● You gain an additional 4 arms and blue-tinted skin, as well as a third eye. The limbs are fully functional and allow you to use the least-injured for Techniques and actions (only the least-damaged remain when you return to normal). Additionally, each complete pair of arms allows you to launch another 1-die Unarmed attack. The third eye allows you to perceive spiritual energy, allowing perfect sight even in complete darkness.

● All of your actions carry the Holy keyword.

● Upon transformation, your Aura completely regenerates. Additionally, it regenerates +1d10 at the end of each round per Awakened Chakra, up to its normal maximum.

● Your Effortless Rank increases by +1.

● You may activate a single Master-level or weaker Technique requiring a functional/Awakened Chakra without paying its cost, once per round.

● While a Chakra is Awakened, you resist its corresponding Element’s damage or ill-effects at (Technique Rank). Due to Heaven’s Supremacy over hell, your Awakened Heaven Chakra grants you complete resistance to Unholy effects.

● You may choose to deal Physical aggravation towards a Prana catastrophe Imbalance rather than normal damage with any attack. Multiply this Aggravation by 2.

● While transformed, your Skill actions are no longer capped. If you are able to achieve a Rank 14+ result, then you act at your Achieved Rank.

This divine transformation lasts for 1 round per Degree you have achieved. It thereafter dissipates unless you sustain it for 50 Prana per round.

Special: Sometimes, this Technique will activate in the defense of a greater good or deep Dharmic purpose. In this case, its cost to activate and sustain are paid by the Kharmic Wheel rather than the character, so long as they defend the sacred thing that destiny has singled out for protection. This special activation is at the sole discretion of the GM.

The rank value given above is only used when boosting spirit.
You deflect a foe’s strike. If your defense exceeds their attack by 10 or more, they lose Advantage or gain Disadvantage as you bat their pathetic strike away with ease.

You may elect to trade the physical damage from any of your attacks for Aggravation towards an Emotional Imbalance. Its Dramatic Penalty involves failure of any action that contradicts a lesson which your are attempting to instill in the recipient. The Imbalance may be healed by learning the lesson or adopting the philosophy or outlook of your choosing.

When you transform the damage of an attack empowered by a Technique, it is discounted by a cost of 1 Prana. Additionally, it carries the Holy keyword
system.techReqs: Internal Balance and Harmony with your Nature

system.requirements: an unshakable sense of self; cannot be used if an emotional Imbalance exceeds your Degree
system.techEffect:
Life Sense: You can sense all living things with a unique new sense. It is similar to both hearing and touch and shares their general range and restriction. You sense each living being distinctly and do not become overwhelmed by a profusion of them (such as when in a dense jungle or a swarm of insects).

Action Before Thought: 0, +1 Rank to Initiative

Strikes all foes in melee range at full effect and strikes any foe of your choice in melee range 1 additional time at (Technique Rank) per Awakened Chakra. Foes damaged by this attack lose 1d10 Prana per successful strike and you gain an equal amount of Prana as you rip their living essence from their meridians and devour it with your hungry Chakra. Squads struck by this attack take an additional 2d10 damage and Prana Drain while Platoons take 4d10.

You surround yourself in an electromagnetic shield of psychic force. In addition to deflecting attacks, it grants you control over any metal within range of your senses; you can move it with incredible force and unerring precision in three dimensions, even shaping it to your whim as a Power action of (Achieved Rank).

You can lift and fully manipulate any metal, with your (Achieved Rank) acting as a Power action. You might manipulate chunks of a structure too big to lift; for example, ripping up and shaping chunks of the metal hull of a battleship.

If your limbs or sense organs are injured, you can use this Technique to create functional facsimiles out of available metal and circuitry. Each lasts for the remainder of the scene, but can be permanently Sustained for the cost of 5 Kharma. 10 Metal Resources replaces 1 Limb.

You command a tempest of air; you direct it and retain control over it even after it strikes a foe. It can push with force equal to (Achieved Rank) as a Power action, but does no damage (although thrown objects deal damage as normal).

If you focus its powers of vacuum or temperature reduction, you can damage foes as though from an environmental suffocation/cold Hazard of (Achieved Rank). The windstorm summoned by this use of the Technique is additionally represented by Cataclysm Dice (p.188) equal to (Achieved Rank) and remains under your control so long as you Sustain it.

Alternatively, you may lift yourself with it, floating and flying as an Agility action of (Achieved Rank); this also creates a shield of wind at (Achieved Rank), protecting you while increasing your movement. This Shield only protects against ranged strikes, cold effects and suffocation (it creates a bubble of protective air around you in aqueous environments).These effects are Sustainable.

You take your ease and strike the foe with effortless grace. If you damage them with this strike, it so intimidates them that it generates an equal amount of Emotional Aggravation towards a Fear Imbalance (as Soul-Wilting Terror, p.130).

Smashing an enemy or the ground, you send a shockwave rippling across this Field at (Achieved Rank). It indiscriminately damages everything, friend, foe and structure alike (although it hits structures at +1 Rank due to the Destructive Keyword). 

The foe is driven into the ground like a railroad spike, and has to dig themselves out before they can move or take any actions. They have Disadvantage while buried, and while piledriven, they’re effectively Grabbed at (Technique Rank) by the surrounding earth.
This technique is elusive; some say it is not a move at all, but the lack of one. It is less expensive than a normal defense, although its delicate harmony is more prone to being disrupted by injury.
system.techReqs: Arm, Reflexive Weapon and Leg or 4 Limbs

system.techEffect: Your skin hardens into seeming indestructibility; you don’t even bleed when shot. If you fail to completely defend against an attack with this Technique, reduce any resulting Aggravation received by 3d10. If the attack has a nondamage component, ignore it (you aren’t poisoned, or cursed, tripped or anything else but damaged) unless powered by a Master-Level Technique or equivalently strong (Rank 6+) effect. If it deals increased Aggravation, reduce the amount by a further 3d10 (for a total of 6d10!).
